shared_elements: incised/carved curvilinear marks on a rock surface (faint and indeterminate in B)
justification: A depicts an unmistakable scene: a keeled boat with upturned prow and stern carrying two schematic silhouetted human figures standing side by side, while B shows essentially a bare rock outcrop over water with, at most, a few faint indeterminate curved incisions and no legible figures. The only possible correspondence is that both surfaces bear carved curvilinear marks, which is far too generic to indicate shared iconography; the boat-with-crew motif has no counterpart in B.
